rebaselinedFrom.reason: Migration was authored on a pre-#34 base. Rebased onto master 86ed9e4, whose legacy build adds the progress-bar sm size and 16/24/32 track sizes. light.css and dark.css hashes are unchanged; only tokens.css moved (561 -> 564 declarations).

identifierRenames.reason: Naming fixes made first in the Figma Tokens v1.0.0 file (variable IDs preserved) and mirrored in the token source: color/data-viz/catergory/* -> category/* (30 variables), categorical data-viz pink -> magenta at the subtle and bold levels (matching the magenta primitives and the default level), and color/green/alpha/500/4 -> 500/04 (matching its alpha siblings).
identifierRenames.verification: For each file, the new output with the deprecated alias lines removed equals the previous output with old names mapped to new ones, line for line - identifiers changed, values, order, and selectors did not.
identifierRenames.deprecatedAliases: Each old custom property is kept as an alias recipe (css-recipes.json) resolving to its new name: 30 in light.css, 30 in dark.css, 1 in tokens.css. See 'Deprecated aliases' in docs/foundations/token-format.md for when they can be removed.

tokenAdditions.reason: A 6px step on the semantic spacing scale (spacing/075, aliasing the 6px primitive), created first in the Figma Tokens v1.0.0 Semantic: Dimension collection and mirrored in the token source. Components used the primitive directly for this distance because the scale had no 6px step.
tokenAdditions.verification: tokens.css with the one added line removed equals the previous tokens.css exactly; light.css and dark.css are unchanged.

tokenAdditions.reason: The overlay elevation shadow as a DTCG shadow composite (Semantic: Elevation, Light and Dark), matching Figma's elevation.shadow.overlay effect style: an inset ring of --border-width-sm in the overlay inner color, a 0 8px 12px drop in the overlay spread color, and a 0 0 1px perimeter. Components wrote this recipe out by hand, or approximated it.
tokenAdditions.verification: light.css and dark.css each gain exactly this one declaration; tokens.css is unchanged.

valueChanges.reason: Figma's Dark overlay effect style draws the inner ring transparent; the variable was solid taupe 500, so code showed a visible ring in Dark only. Changed first in Figma (Tokens v1.0.0, variable ID unchanged), then here. Light was already transparent.
valueChanges.verification: dark.css differs from the previous file by this one value and the added --elevation-shadow-overlay line.

tokenRemovals.reason: Figma Tokens v1.0.0 has no color/content/subtler variable, so code carried a leftover. Its only component use was Key Value Pair's field icons, where it measured 2.25:1 (Light) and 2.74:1 (Dark), below the 3:1 icons need; they now use the fields' own color-content-subtle.
tokenRemovals.verification: light.css and dark.css each lose exactly this one declaration; tokens.css is unchanged.
